response_texts: What are you doing? Eliminate the intruders immediately! Don't let them get any closer to the laboratory!
Answer me! Is no one there? You're all getting a cut to your wages!
Ozwald, it's unusual for you to bring here anything else than a corpse, isn't it?
Is that so? So, what's that one's condition, then?
He hasn't shown any signs of mutation yet. He's very stable.
She hasn't shown any signs of mutation yet. She's very stable.
That's unusual. By now the affected are already dead or become ghouls. What's different with this one?
I don't really understand. Something seems to be restraining the curse... Is he from the same province as you?
I don't really understand. Something seems to be restraining the curse... Is she from the same province as you?
I've never seen this person. Well, if there's no fear of mutation, I might have found myself another hunter.
Oh, Ozwald... Are you seriously saying that?
Why not? This one proved to be a good match for mutated Felix. Should be useful.
That's not it. He's an outsider and doesn't know anything. Do you think he'll just willingly join the witch hunt?
That's not it. She's an outsider and doesn't know anything. Do you think she'll just willingly join the witch hunt?
If not, death is the only solution.
Why do you have to be so difficult? I beg you, no killing here, please!
It all depends on this one's answer.
Ha ha, you should really calm... Wait, he's awake!
Ha ha, you should really calm... Wait, she's awake!
Um, I'm searching for someone... Did you see anyone looking like a hunter? They're my junior.
Wouldn't you rather pick me up instead? It would be hilarious!
Oh, it would? Well, anyway... I'm looking for someone. Excuse me...
Hey, you can do better than that! You could boil a soul gem with me. It would be fun.
Soul gem boiling? I'd love to! But I'm at work at the moment...
What a surprise, so am I. So why don't we do it together, hmm?
Hmm, this might be fate. I'm feeling sorry for my junior, but now I absolutely have to do this!
What a clever baby... This is good! Good! Wonderful!
Boom! And then the bearman with a bounty on his head blew up his forge and tried to take us with him.
What happened then?
That blast was nothing but a breeze for us. We've escaped from the cave before it crumbled down.
But we left something important there... Do you know what it was, Lalanoah?
Um... what was it? Oh... I know! You left the bounty, right?
Yes, Lalanoah. We left the criminal's head there. And so we have no prize gold...
I'm really sorry, Lalanoah. If we had that gold, we could send you to a good school...
Don't worry, uncle Brandt. It's fine, I can be here with everyone! And when I grow up, I will go to the Temple of Kynareth.
The Temple is closer to Falkreath than the Imperial City, too, so it will be easy to visit everyone.
Lalanoah... are you sure? If you went to the Imperial City, you'd be able to eat many different sweets.
Hmmm... Well, maybe I'll think about it.
Not like this... But this is not the end. I have a mission to finish...
Come on. Accept your defeat. Your head will pay a nice sum, enough for our school expenses.
Ha, a good one... but there'll be nothing left. If I'm going down, then I'm taking you with me!
Damn! Get away from here before it all breaks down!
This stench of rot... it cannot hide your inhuman nature. So you are already horribly cursed, hmm? A monster, no better than a common beast.
It is unworthy ones like you who curse the day and awaken Alkhan. That is why we must hunt you down.
Hmm, it's badly damaged...
Don't just stand there, we need to investigate what happened here.
Come on, let's go home. Get ready, Barbas.
I'm so happy to have a master who's so rough with dogs...
Yeah yeah, aren't you glad? Now use that proud nose of yours and show us the way out.
So long, friend. Don't stay here too long.
Stop wasting your breath, Barbas! Come on! I just want to get out of here already.
If you stay here too long, you won't be able to leave. Be careful.
The Drop prefers blood. Not just any blood. Her daughter's. Let us kill her. Let us kill her and fill the Drop with her blood.
Let us end it... the bloodline of the whore who betrayed Kyne... It would be a kindness to spill her blood and use her flesh as an offering.
...You're being awfully chatty today, aren't you? Shadows like you should keep their mouths shut. Don't interfere with our work.
We must all partake in the Feast of Kyne. Give us the daughter.
Enough of this... bullshit! Buddy, if he runs to Hinnom, we're done for. Let's finish him off, right here and now!
She is a blue bird, albeit a duckling. She is our redemption. Let us pluck her feathers, let us sacrifice her!
This looks somewhat like a stone. Is this the Red Drop? But it's gray...
It's like her stomach was torn apart... Her guts are spilling out... It's odd, though. There's way too much for just one person's internal organs...
Begin the ritual, then, and I will leave. For mine does not need to be the name the baby calls.
May you find at least some peace where you're headed. Farewell.
My Lord, you have enlightened the slaves of the sea with freedom. And yet, because of that they grew thirsty.
Why have you carved yourself so? With each word that divides you, your blade grows smaller and thinner...
I... I recognize this staff... my mom had it...
Hey... This is Laelnoah's staff. Orlando, where did you get this?
I bought it from some men in strange helmets near Helgen. Is something wrong with it?
Where did they go? Tell me, Orlando!
Customer information is not easily disclosed. As an adult, you should know this, Brandt.
Look, here's the gold. Just tell me, quickly.
Piper's Hill. It's supposed to be south of Bloodlet Throne and past the Jerall Mountains.
Thank you. And sell me this staff, will you? It belonged to Lalanoah's mother.
You can have it for free. Don't worry about it, I purchased it for 10 gold.
...You're a pretty nice person. I thought you were a miserable old miser until now, but you've made me change my mind.
Keep that in mind until the end.
Oblivion take it all, this again! Security in Falkreath is the worst!
O raging soul, o tainted soul. You should give this up. It is that chick you must kill.
The blue bird is already blue even in infancy. She is our redemption. Let us cut off her beak, let us sacrifice her!
O raging soul, o tainted soul. Do not do this. It is that chick that must be killed.
All because she was born blue. She is our redemption. Let us gut her, let us sacrifice her!
I'll be waiting for you in Alcaire. See you soon.
